steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: A stimulus is the starting point or inspiration for creating a dance | Key Fact: There are five main types of stimulus: visual, auditory, kinaesthetic, ideational and literary | Key Fact: A visual stimulus is something you see — a painting, photograph, sculpture or film | Key Fact: An auditory stimulus is something you hear — music, natural sounds, spoken word or silence

steps.title: Homework & Consolidation
steps.body: Consolidation, retrieval on key terms from stimulus &amp; starting points, and one past-paper question.
